summary:
Detailed implementation plan to achieve:
1. True UI Style Desktop Layout Architecture (full shell layout adaptation for macOS with top menu + bottom dock + traffic lights, One UI top viewing / bottom thumb interaction reachability, MIUI Alive superellipse widgets, Material 3 left rail/bottom M3 pills, The AI HUD, Nyan Cat, Meme, and Glassium).
2. Dynamic SVG Displacement Filter for Liquid Glass Refraction (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap + feSpecularLighting with mouse pointer ripple dynamics).
3. Design Subtraction (引き算の美学) across Sleep Screen and Desktop (customizable clock position, weather showing ONLY temperature like 21°C, removal of all redundant pills, clutter, and verbose labels).
4. Continuous high-fps animated sleep canvas backgrounds.
5. Stylish, subtle, luxury Web Audio API system sound effects.
6. Full Browser proxy fix with reliable URL rewriting and responsive iframe fallback.
7. Strict ban on emojis in favor of dynamic SVG vector icons.
